name: home-craft
description: Build, adapt or review a native Swift/SwiftUI iOS app for Apple CarPlay and Apple HomeView on iOS 26 and 27. Picks the one CarPlay entitlement, wires the car scene for a car-only cold launch, keeps Now Playing on one framework, and ships Swift templates that type-check against the iOS 27 SDK plus a 24-rule static audit. HomeView has no SDK: an app reaches it as a CarPlay audio or video app from a paired iPhone, or as a small widget, and the skill says which.
